Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of CVX.
Our gross margin expanded by 137 basis points to 25.2%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2022.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $3.17 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 137 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Thank you for the question. We generated $5.7 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
